summary: Marcus, a detained teenager, is told by a woman that the DHS has been expelled from the state, its checkpoints dismantled, and officers involved in stress interrogations face jail, and that he will be bailed out rather than sent to a rough juvenile facility. Still dazed, he asks to find his friends Ange Carvelli and Darryl Glover, but after searching the cell block calling their names he gets no answer, fears they were shipped overseas, and sits down overcome, thinking bitterly of the woman who interrogated him.
one_line: Marcus, freed from a DHS detention facility, searches for missing friends Ange and Darryl while processing the government's collapse.
key_facts: The Governor has thrown the DHS out of the State and dismantled every checkpoint.
The Attorney General has issued warrants for law-enforcement officers involved in 'stress interrogations' and secret imprisonments.
The speaker says the old justice system with judges, open trials and lawyers is replacing the 'bizarro-world version' of the justice system.
The speaker suggests Marcus could be transferred to a juvie facility on the mainland, but warns those places can be really rough.
The speaker says this detention facility may be the best place for Marcus until he is bailed out.
Marcus says he had not been charged yet but believes there would be plenty of charges.
The speaker says the officers will go to jail because of what Marcus did.
Marcus wants to find Ange and Darryl and tries to look up their cell-numbers on a computer but it requires a password.
Marcus and his companion walk the corridors calling out 'Ange Carvelli' and 'Darryl Glover'.
Prisoners behind the cell-doors scream, cry or beg to be let go.
Former guards are herded onto the docks in plastic handcuffs and taken away by California state SWAT teams.
Marcus believes Ange and Darryl have been shipped overseas to Syria or worse.
Marcus recalls Severe Haircut Woman smirking as she asked him for his login.
Marcus thinks that when he sees Severe Haircut Woman again he might want to harm her.
